provenance: The two baselines: MCC's own exported default, and a project the user initialised and exported without touching anything. Confirmed on the hardware readout only for BPM, which shows 120.
comment: These matter more than they look. An empty project is the one case where a reader that mistakes uninitialised storage for content fails loudly instead of subtly -- Track 1 slot 4 is zero-filled rather than sentinel-filled in every known file, which naively reads as 64 notes at step 1 with velocity 0, in both parameter sets, in all 16 patterns.

projects.description: MCC's factory template, shipped with the application.
Initialised and exported by the user with no edits made.
